text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- An election court declared the election for the Bukit Begunan constituency in the eastern Malaysia state of Sarawak on Borneo island, null and void due to the alleged use of money to influence voters. The elections had been held on September 8 and 9, 1996.
-- The Home Ministry is studying methods used by Middle Eastern countries in deporting illegal foreign workers, said Deputy Home Minister Megat Junid Megat Ayub on Thursday.

-- Hong Kong-based Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd has expressed satisfaction with its 14.25 percent stake in vehicle distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd, despite market talk that it is trying to exert more influence on the company.
-- Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd which provides credit ratings for private debt securities, is to provide is going to provide industry performance indicators.
